## Checklist

Everything here:

- [ ] No ISPConfig core file is modified, and no database schema is added
- [ ] Ran `php -l` on every changed `.php` and `.lng`, and `bash -n` on changed shell

If it touches **clarity**:

- [ ] Colors come from `tokens.css` semantic tokens (`--nz-*`) — no hard-coded values in components
- [ ] New tokens have a light-mode value in the remap block (`--nz-rail-accent` excepted — never remap it)
- [ ] Checked in dark **and** light mode, and the mobile drawer if the frame changed
- [ ] The contracts in `themes/clarity/BUILT-AGAINST.txt` still hold

If it touches **classic**:

- [ ] `brand.php` overrides only stock's own selectors — classic has no stylesheet
      of its own, so `--nz-*` custom properties do not exist there
- [ ] No file under `themes/classic/templates/` was edited or committed — that
      shell is generated by `install.sh` from the panel's own stock templates
- [ ] Checked the login scene too (`brand.php?scene=login`), which is scoped by
      URL rather than by a body class

If it touches a **pre-auth endpoint** (`brand.php`, `title.php`, `favicon.php`):

- [ ] Still works with no session: no app bootstrap, no session start, one
      read-only query
- [ ] Reads the RAW `sys_ini` column — never `getconf::get_global_config()`,
      which strips slashes with no counterpart on write
- [ ] Every value validated for its output context before it is emitted, and URL
      patterns keep the `/D` modifier
- [ ] Degrades to a valid empty/no-op response when the database is unreachable
- [ ] Locates the panel without trusting `__DIR__` alone — the default install is
      a symlink and PHP resolves `__DIR__` through it

If it touches the **Branding page** or a stored setting:

- [ ] The setting works on **both** designs, or the reason it cannot is written down
- [ ] All seven `*_customizer.lng` files have the key — CI enforces exact parity
- [ ] `bin/purge_branding.php` clears anything new
